title: Half size when little volume traded between entry and target (thin path) (neighbour: 0.8 x median instead of 0.7 x median)
question: Neighbour check of vp_thin_path: same idea at threshold 0.8. Thin path: the last 5 sessions traded little volume between entry and target (< 0.7x median)?
notes: Post-hoc on the exact live-loop replay (768 baseline trades, costs included); only the size changes. Features from data/NQ_5m.csv at the signal close (no look-ahead). Strong side chosen on 2021-25 only (except the re-checks). Reproduce: python tools/research_vp.py all

sizing.rule: x0.5 on the weak side (every trade still taken)
sizing.on_top_of: live sizing incl. the cold-streak half size

method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
